name: maps-noir-harness
description: Google Map Dark Mode -- the extension plus its verification harness. `npm test` is the fast offline regression suite (no browser, no network); `npm run test:theme` adds the app-chrome theme suite, which launches a browser but needs no network; the live gate drives real pointer gestures against live Maps and asserts that the dark map survives sustained interaction. The shipped version number lives in extension/manifest.*.json, never here -- tools/package.mjs reads it from there and refuses to build if the two manifests disagree.

scripts.test:full: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:theme && npm run test:dnr && npm run test:liveness
